execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"
CREATE TYPE "public"."ContactStatus" AS ENUM ('NEW', 'IN_REVIEW', 'RESPONDED', 'RESOLVED', 'ARCHIVED')
CREATE TYPE "public"."DeploymentStatus" AS ENUM ('ASSIGNED', 'EN_ROUTE', 'ON_SITE', 'CHECKED_IN', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED')
CREATE TYPE "public"."MissionPriority" AS ENUM ('CRITICAL', 'HIGH', 'MEDIUM', 'LOW')
CREATE TYPE "public"."MissionStatus" AS ENUM ('STAGED', 'ACTIVE', 'CONTAINED', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED')
CREATE TYPE "public"."UserRole" AS ENUM ('SUPER_ADMIN', 'COORDINATOR', 'TEAM_LEAD', 'VOLUNTEER')
CREATE TYPE "public"."VolunteerStatus" AS ENUM ('ACTIVE', 'DEPLOYED', 'AVAILABLE', 'RESTRICTED', 'INACTIVE')

CREATE TABLE "public"."audit_logs" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "entity_id" int4,
  "entity_type" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "ip_address" text,
  "new_values" jsonb,
  "old_values" jsonb,
  "user_agent" text,
  "user_id" int4,
  CONSTRAINT "audit_logs_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."communications" (
  "channel_id" text DEFAULT 'general' NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "event_id" int4,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "media_url" text,
  "message" text NOT NULL,
  "message_type" text DEFAULT 'text' NOT NULL,
  "priority" text DEFAULT 'normal' NOT NULL,
  "sender_id" int4,
  "sender_name" text NOT NULL,
  "sender_role" text DEFAULT 'coordinator' NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "communications_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."contact_submissions" (
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "inquiry_type" text DEFAULT 'general' NOT NULL,
  "ip_address" text,
  "message" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "organization" text,
  "response_notes" text,
  "status" "ContactStatus" DEFAULT 'NEW'::"ContactStatus" NOT NULL,
  "subject" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "contact_submissions_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."deployments" (
  "assigned_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "assigned_by" int4,
  "check_in_latitude" numeric(10,7),
  "check_in_longitude" numeric(10,7),
  "check_in_method" text,
  "check_in_time" timestamp(3),
  "completed_at" timestamp(3),
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "event_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "status" "DeploymentStatus" DEFAULT 'ASSIGNED'::"DeploymentStatus" NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "volunteer_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "deployments_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."dispatch_jobs" (
  "attempts" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "job_type" text NOT NULL,
  "last_error" text,
  "locked_at" timestamp(3),
  "locked_by" text,
  "max_attempts" int4 DEFAULT 3 NOT NULL,
  "payload" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "priority" int4 DEFAULT 10 NOT NULL,
  "processed_at" timestamp(3),
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "dispatch_jobs_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."events" (
  "coordinator_id" int4,
  "coordinator_name" text,
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "end_date" timestamp(3),
  "event_name" text NOT NULL,
  "event_type" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "location_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "priority" "MissionPriority" DEFAULT 'MEDIUM'::"MissionPriority" NOT NULL,
  "required_skills" jsonb,
  "required_volunteers" int4 DEFAULT 10 NOT NULL,
  "start_date" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "status" "MissionStatus" DEFAULT 'ACTIVE'::"MissionStatus" NOT NULL,
  "tags" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "events_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."feedback" (
  "comments" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deployment_id" int4,
  "event_id" int4,
  "feedback_time" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "rating" int4 NOT NULL,
  "submitted_via" text DEFAULT 'mobile_app' NOT NULL,
  "volunteer_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "feedback_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."field_reports" (
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deployment_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "file_upload_url" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "latitude" numeric(10,7),
  "longitude" numeric(10,7),
  "media_url" text,
  "priority" text DEFAULT 'medium' NOT NULL,
  "report_time" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "report_type" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'submitted' NOT NULL,
  "submitted_via" text DEFAULT 'mobile_app' NOT NULL,
  "text_response" text NOT NULL,
  "verified_by" text,
  CONSTRAINT "field_reports_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."locations" (
  "address" text NOT NULL,
  "city" text,
  "country" text DEFAULT 'USA',
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "hazard_level" text DEFAULT 'low' NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "latitude" numeric(10,7) NOT NULL,
  "longitude" numeric(10,7) NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "osm_id" int4,
  "radius_meters" int4 DEFAULT 5000 NOT NULL,
  "state" text,
  CONSTRAINT "locations_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."notifications" (
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "event_id" int4,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "message" text NOT NULL,
  "notification_type" text NOT NULL,
  "priority" text DEFAULT 'normal' NOT NULL,
  "read_at" timestamp(3),
  "sent_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "sent_by" int4,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'sent' NOT NULL,
  "title" text DEFAULT 'Operational Alert' NOT NULL,
  "volunteer_id" int4,
  CONSTRAINT "notifications_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."refresh_tokens" (
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "family" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "ip_address" text,
  "is_revoked" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "token_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "user_agent" text,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "refresh_tokens_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."skills" (
  "category" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "demand_level" text DEFAULT 'medium' NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "skill_name" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "skills_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."telemetry_pings" (
  "altitude" numeric(8,2),
  "battery_level" int4,
  "heading" numeric(5,2),
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "is_distress" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "latitude" numeric(10,7) NOT NULL,
  "longitude" numeric(10,7) NOT NULL,
  "recorded_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "speed" numeric(6,2),
  "volunteer_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "telemetry_pings_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "avatar_url" text,
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "full_name" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "is_active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "last_login_at" timestamp(3),
  "password_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "phone_number" text,
  "role" "UserRole" DEFAULT 'VOLUNTEER'::"UserRole" NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "users_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."volunteer_skills" (
  "certification_date" timestamp(3),
  "certified_by" text,
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "is_certified" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "proficiency_level" text DEFAULT 'intermediate' NOT NULL,
  "skill_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "volunteer_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "volunteer_skills_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."volunteers" (
  "address" text,
  "availability_schedule" jsonb,
  "avatar_url" text,
  "badge_count" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "bio" text,
  "consent_given" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "date_of_birth" timestamp(3),
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "emergency_contact" text,
  "full_name" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "latitude" numeric(10,7),
  "longitude" numeric(10,7),
  "phone_number" text NOT NULL,
  "registration_channel" text DEFAULT 'inbuilt' NOT NULL,
  "registration_date" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "status" "VolunteerStatus" DEFAULT 'AVAILABLE'::"VolunteerStatus" NOT NULL,
  "total_hours" numeric(10,2) DEFAULT ('0'::numeric(10,2)) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4,
  CONSTRAINT "volunteers_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
